comments.text:
Which part of life in Tajikistan surprised you the most — the marriage traditions, the beauty standards, the missing men, or the government's restrictions on clothing?
And which Central Asian country should we explore next?

comments.author: @CathyCrawford-l7w
comments.text:
I'd never heard of Tajikistan until now.  I guess I need more geography lessons.  I'm in awe of it's beautiful lakes & mountains.  But the social restrictions are mind-boggling. I can't imagine living like that especially the women. We are truly blessed in the USA.
From Grover, North Carolina USA
